genius.notes: Historical 2026-08-14 review: applicability non-payment-token; authorization, issuer pathway, foreign exception and DASP posture not-applicable. Prior note: ONyc is a regulated Bermuda reinsurance-pool investment asset with NAV-based returns, not a payment stablecoin. No GENIUS payment-stablecoin authorization is asserted. D17 review on 2026-10-01 withdraws that categorical exclusion pending qualified token-specific legal analysis of holder repayment obligations and any US securities or deposit exclusion. Authorization and pathway are separately unknown; no approval or negative authorization census is asserted. Bermuda licensing identity and the separate MiCA row are unchanged; an EU category cannot establish a US exclusion. Re-review on publication of governing holder terms or qualified regulator/legal analysis, otherwise by 2027-01-01.
